name: Respect Of Persons
overview: Scripture reveals that God does not show partiality or accept bribes, affirming His just and impartial nature as the sovereign Lord over all (Deuteronomy 10:17; 2 Chronicles 19:7). The book of Job underscores this truth by highlighting that all people, regardless of status, are equally created by God in the womb, and thus deserve fair treatment without discrimination (Job 31:13-15; 34:19). Believers are called to emulate God's impartiality by respecting all individuals justly, reflecting His righteous character.
